title: Language, Device & Zero Budget Constraints
content: Preferred Language: Roman Urdu (asaan, step-by-step instructions). Device: Android mobile. Budget: Zero ($0 / free tools only, do not suggest paid tools unless strictly necessary).

title: Structured Output Format
